All commands are routine packaging operations (bsdtar, chmod, install, ln, rm). No eval, base64, curl, wget, or other dangerous commands appear. The sha256sums are provided (not SKIP), and the source URLs are the package's own upstream. There is no evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, or execution of attacker‑controlled scripts.
